title: NASA's Sun fact sheet lists luminosity 382.8×10^24 J/s
summary: The sheet's luminosity row is 382.8 in units of 10^24 joules per second.
body: NASA's Sun fact sheet lists luminosity as 382.8 × 10^24 J/s. That is the sheet's figure, read with the column headed luminosity (10^24 J/s). It is not a rounded slogan and it is not the mass or the radius, which are on the earlier Sun card.

sources.title: Sun Fact Sheet
sources.author: Dr. David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, NSSDCA
